claims.text: The proposed composition is Fe22Ni16Co19Mn12Cr16P15.
Relative to Cr16Mn16Fe16Co16Ni16P20, the intervention increases Fe from 16 to 22 at.%.
Relative to Cr16Mn16Fe16Co16Ni16P20, the intervention increases Co from 16 to 19 at.%.
Relative to Cr16Mn16Fe16Co16Ni16P20, the intervention decreases Mn from 16 to 12 at.%.
Relative to Cr16Mn16Fe16Co16Ni16P20, the intervention decreases P from 20 to 15 at.%.
Melt spinning at 40 m/s is expected to produce approximately 20 μm thick ribbons.
The composition change combined with rapid melt spinning will improve glass-forming ability.
The composition change combined with rapid melt spinning will improve the thermal stability of the amorphous state.
The compositional tuning reduces the stability of the primary solid-solution phase.
The compositional tuning limits high-temperature phosphide formation.
Reduced primary-phase stability and limited phosphide formation promote cooperative eutectic solidification.
Rapid cooling prevents elemental partitioning.
The relevant eutectic-based microstructure consists of fine, rod-like eutectic colonies.
Rapid quenching suppresses phosphide nucleation.
Rapidly melt-spun Fe22Ni16Co19Mn12Cr16P15 ribbons will be fully amorphous.
The modified ribbons will have a broader devitrification interval than the baseline alloy and slower-cooled ingots.
The modified ribbons will exhibit a simpler, predominantly eutectic transformation sequence during DSC heating.
The Cr16Mn16Fe16Co16Ni16P20 baseline exhibited multiple crystallization arrests arising from mixed eutectic and primary phases.
The predicted improvement is expected only under rapid-cooling conditions such as melt spinning to approximately 20 μm thickness.
Bulk or slower-cooled samples are expected to exhibit multiphase crystallization similar to the baseline.

contradictions.description: The material initial state is already specified as Fe22Ni16Co19Mn12Cr16P15, while the intervention is framed as modifying the alloy to that same composition from the P20 baseline. This makes the actual pre-intervention starting material ambiguous.

The mediator and mechanism invoke preservation of a fine rod-like eutectic structure and cooperative eutectic solidification, both of which imply crystalline phase growth, whereas the predicted ribbon is fully amorphous. The text does not clearly distinguish eutectic-composition effects before vitrification from an actual crystalline eutectic microstructure.
